title: fix(scenarios): prefix an operation's via with the card namespace
body:

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;内部场景评测在打分时,能认出构建通过卡片自带动作完成的审批。
- 为什么做:属于场景评测记分,修好上次修复的遗漏:卡片名字加前缀后,路由动作名没跟着加,所以从未匹配上。
- 出错会怎样:只影响评测打分,不影响任何应用;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes
- `namespacedScenario` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/namespace.ts`) now prefixes `run.operations[].via` with the card namespace, the same way it already prefixes `run.agentActions[].name`, and only when `via` is present.
- Before: on the namespaced card a `via` stayed bare (`decide_approval_step`) while the action it names became `demoleave_decide_approval_step`, so the persona-grant check's `buildDeclaresAction` (`src/score/scenario-tags.ts`) never matched by `===`, and `persona-grant:dept_manager:*_approval_step:update` failed on leave_balances, requisition_to_receipt and travel_expense although each build declares the action (eval comments 7087195956 and 7116578174 on the card).
- Ruling 7077801044 item 3 (C) is unchanged; this only makes the namespaced card carry the route the ruling describes.
- `Part of`, not `Fixes`: the card closes on an eval-lane re-run.

## Tests
- New pin in the existing `namespace-relative cards` block (`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/units.test.ts`): on every card that routes an operation (3 operations across leave_balances, requisition_to_receipt, travel_expense), the namespaced `via` is one of the namespaced `run.agentActions` on that operation's object — the loader's own rule, now holding on the namespaced card too; leave_balances reads `demoleave_decide_approval_step`; a card with no `via` gets none invented.
- Red before the fix at the base commit: `leave_balances manager_approves_step_one via decide_approval_step: expected false to be true`.
- Ablation after committing the fix (55cfe87d11): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the new line (anchor 1 -> 0, blob changed), the pin went red with the same message; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob hash matches HEAD.

## Acceptance notes
- Other readers of `op.via`: the loader (`src/loader.ts` ~928) validates the plain card before namespacing, and `personaGrantNeeds` (`src/score/scenario-tags.ts` ~990) reads the namespaced card; with both names prefixed together, the two agree.

## Verification
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/units.test.ts -t 'namespace-relative'` — expect 5 passed, including the new `via` pin.
- Read first: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/namespace.ts` (the one added line in the `operations` map).
